what: The photo frame border is cut in a stone-like shape rather than an ellipse, and cycles in straight lines through four shapes (corner percentages beyond 100%) over 20s, swaying slowly

options.look: Type — default is a horizontally long stone (place photo), ”pebble” is a pebble flattened on one side (facility photo), ”round” is a round bubble
options.--fx-dur: Length of one rotation (via style), default 20s
options.--fx-delay: Delay (via style) — give a negative value and several sheets start from different shapes
options.--fx-b1~--fx-b4: When giving the four-corner border-radius directly (via style or the user’s css)

note: CSS only. Fill the cell with the inner photo (object-fit: cover) and only the border ripples

from.where: index.html place photo (.blob-animation-1 type) · produce facility photo (.blob-animation-2 type), about.html next-section photo — border-radius four types 20s linear infinite
